primary.title: ₹1,000 monthly SIP became ₹4.67 lakh in 10 years: Which diversified equity mutual fund delivered highest returns?
primary.summary: A ₹1,000 monthly SIP can grow substantially over a decade as returns compound. We look at diversified equity mutual funds that delivered the highest 10-year SIP returns, with Quant Small Cap Fund leading the list. Here’s how the funds compare.
